## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Web Development](https://byabdullahkhan.com/#overview): Bespoke, performant, mobile-first websites built with modern web technologies (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, clean semantic HTML5) tailored to brand identity.
- [Webflow & Scalable CMS Architecture](https://byabdullahkhan.com/#services): Fast, responsive, client-friendly CMS setups that enable non-technical teams to manage blogs, portfolios, dynamic landing pages, and service catalogs effortlessly.
- [Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals](https://byabdullahkhan.com/#overview): Semantic schema markup, ultra-fast TTFB, perfect PageSpeed scores, zero cumulative layout shift (CLS), indexation auditing, and structured data hierarchy.
- [Interactive GSAP & Motion Experience](https://byabdullahkhan.com/#overview): Hardware-accelerated 60fps animations, interactive product showcases, and micro-interactions that elevate brand credibility without sacrificing performance.
- [Full-Funnel CRO & Landing Pages](https://byabdullahkhan.com/#webflow_journey): High-conversion lead generation systems designed to turn paid and organic visitors into paying customers.
